purpose: Audit fixture for authenticated iWAN publisher download calibration; not loaded by runtime.

buildUnderTest.note: beta18 is the Science hotfix. The response-layer reader now rejects a body that starts with HTML at its first bytes (wrong-object-html / wrong-object), which is what the 348-byte viewer shell needed, and GetContent failures report get-content-failed / no-body. The two byte paths are measured separately (downloadEventBytes), a running download event never yields save-pdf-ready and never invents a total for itself, and saveReady is now literally nextAction === 'save-pdf-ready' instead of a second derivation. The fallback entry became a verifiable route: the plugin only offers it for that Science article (exact host, https, no port, DOI must match, not already the download URL) and the new lab_browser_navigate(routeId, expectedPageSeq) carries no URL at all - the shell builds the target from the page it is on, once per task, only for publisher Science before any download, with the page sequence it just reported; without such a route the status says manual-handoff. stalled and verification now force their nextAction, and the observe script walks same-origin iframes. Live selector verification against authenticated iWAN publishers - including Science over the campus network - is still pending for every entry below.
